tips.text: Break the Vomvalyst shell only when you are ready to switch to your Operator; the energy form reforms after 20 seconds.
Use an Amp for the Operator attack; it makes the energy form far easier to finish.
Count your Nano Spores before you start; 12,500 can be a bigger blocker than the cores on a low stash.
Players call this a super easy farm: one Plains night, or a Teralyst hunt, covers the cores.
